% Pattern: theorem/newenvironment/article. An environment of sub-theorems
% that the paper defines and never uses. Its counter commands and its
% \def\thetheorem are code of the environment, not of the paper.
% seen in the gold pilot (set X)
% want theorem-1 statement/theorem 2.1
% want lemma-1 statement/lemma 2.2
\documentclass[10pt]{article}
\numberwithin{equation}{section}
\newtheorem{theorem}{Theorem}[section]
\newtheorem{lemma}[theorem]{Lemma}
\makeatletter
\newcounter{parenttheorem}%
\newenvironment{subassumptions}{%
  \refstepcounter{theorem}%
  \protected@edef\theparenttheorem{\thetheorem}%
  \setcounter{parenttheorem}{\value{theorem}}%
  \setcounter{theorem}{0}%
  \def\thetheorem{\theparenttheorem\normalfont\alph{theorem}}%
  \ignorespaces
}{%
  \setcounter{theorem}{\value{parenttheorem}}%
  \ignorespacesafterend
}
\makeatother
\begin{document}
\section{One}
\section{Two}
\begin{theorem} Each tree is a graph. \end{theorem}
\begin{lemma} Each path is a tree. \end{lemma}
\end{document}
